target: forge.sh pr-close (github) — runs gh pr close on the URL and prints the resulting state
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_gh pr_close 0 ''
fx_gh pr_view 0 CLOSED
fx_run pr-close https://github.com/o/r/pull/3; fx_show r
echo "closes=$(fx_count gh pr close)"
fx_calls_text
fx_done
